## Purpose

Lists the system and custom roles and opens a role's permission matrix ([access-admin flow](../../flows/access-admin/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

A view (page) folder registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`; it reads data only through feature facades ([cms-admin rules](../../apps/cms-admin/RULES.md)).

## Technologies

React, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

Route `/roles`, page `RolesPage`.

## Where to change what

Role data and hooks: `features/access`. The matrix: `views/role-permissions`.
